thread:
maya: Quick fyi — ACME pushed us: they want parity with CompetitorX's multi-tenant routing UI before pilot next month. Sales just escalated.
sam: how urgent is this? do we need full parity or just the 'route-by-tenant' checkbox?
ruth-sales: Customer will sign pilot if routing UI supports 'per-tenant traffic split' and per-route SLOs visible. Their PM said it's blocker. timeline: 4 weeks.
jon: Engineering takes ~6w for full parity (backend + console). We can do a 2w shim: configurable routing alias + limited UI (read-only) + rollout flag.
elena: Design effort for true parity ~3w. Shim UI could be a minimal 'routing alias' form — simpler.
maya: Ok tradeoff call: do we accept shim for pilot (sales? legal?), or deprioritize parity and propose product differentiation? Need launch criteria.
ruth-sales: Shim gets deal signed. They care about immediate functionality more than UX polish. Need SLA/rollback plan documented.
sam: If shim, we have to ensure telemetry: per-tenant latency/cost breakdown and a quick manual rollback. Also need canary config: 5% -> 50% -> 100%.
jon: Agree. Proposed rollout config in repo:
```yaml
rollout:
  stages: [5,50,100]
  monitoring: [latency, error_rate, cost_per_token]
```
We'll add a 'compat-mode' toggle for model variants.
archibot: canary created: acme-routing-shim v0.1 — deploy started
maya: Decision: go shim + canary. Action items: Eng -> PR for backend + toggle (jon), Design -> routing alias UX + microcopy (elena), Sales -> draft acceptance criteria + legal signoff (ruth). We'll timebox 2w. If any metric regresses >5% we'll rollback. :thumbsup:
jon: Starting work today. I'll post daily stand updates in this thread. ETA for first stg is 5 business days.
elena: I'll post mock in Figma link: https://figma.com/file/abc123/routing-alias — will keep it minimal.
ruth-sales: I'll schedule a signoff call w/ ACME for Friday. Need a clear demo script.
maya: :calendar: Weekly sync Fri 10am. Thanks all.
